info.name: L'ÉDITION Magazine Backend API (Full Collection)
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection for the **L'ÉDITION Magazine Platform Backend** (.NET 10.0 + SQL Server + Dapper + EF Core).

### Included APIs & Default Base URLs
1. **MagizineAdmin.Api**: `{{adminBaseUrl}}` (`http://localhost:5024` | HTTPS: `https://localhost:7036`)
2. **MagizineAuthor.Api**: `{{authorBaseUrl}}` (`http://localhost:5267` | HTTPS: `https://localhost:7137`)
3. **MagizinePublic.Api**: `{{publicBaseUrl}}` (`http://localhost:5080` | HTTPS: `https://localhost:7080`)

### Features
- **26-char ULID Identifiers** pre-populated from default SQL Server seed data (`MagizineDB`).
- **Auto-Chaining Test Scripts**: Running `Create` endpoints automatically updates `{{categoryId}}`, `{{authorId}}`, `{{articleId}}`, `{{articleSlug}}`, and `{{authorArticleId}}` collection variables.
- **Standard Result<T> Assertions**: Built-in Postman tests verify `HTTP 200`, `RespType: "Success"`, and `RespCode: "MS#000"`.

item.name: 1. MagizineAdmin.Api (Port 5024)
item.description:
Back-office editorial administration API (`MagizineAdmin.Api`).

Includes full CRUD and status workflows for:
- Article Categories (`/api/admin/article-category`)
- Authors (`/api/admin/author`)
- Articles (`/api/admin/article`)
- Request Articles / Pitches (`/api/admin/requestarticle`)

request.description: Returns a paged list of active (non-deleted) article categories ordered by `SortOrder` and `Name`.
Fetches a single article category by its 26-character ULID (`ArticleCategoryId`).
Creates a new article category with a server-generated 26-char ULID. Automatically stores `Data.ArticleCategoryId` into `{{createdCategoryId}}`.

body.raw:
{
  "ArticleCategoryId": "{{createdCategoryId}}",
  "Name": "Culture & Design",
  "Slug": "culture-design",
  "Description": "Updated description for contemporary art, design, and architecture.",
  "SortOrder": 4
}

request.description: Updates an existing article category's `Name`, `Slug`, `Description`, and `SortOrder`.
Soft-deletes an article category (`IsDeleted = true`). Protected against deletion if non-deleted articles reference this category.

item.name: 1.2 Author
item.description: Manage magazine authors (`Tbl_Author`) via Dapper (`fn_get_author_list`, `fn_get_author_by_id`) and EF Core.

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of authors using stored procedure `dbo.fn_get_author_list`. Supports filtering by `SearchKeyword`, `IsApproved`, and `IsActive`.
Retrieves author profile details by 26-char ULID via stored procedure `dbo.fn_get_author_by_id`.

request.description: Updates an existing author's profile fields and regenerates their slug if their name changed.
Toggles `IsApproved` and `IsActive` flags for an author account.
Soft-deletes an author (`IsDeleted = true`, `IsActive = false`). Blocked if the author still has active articles.

request.description: Executes `dbo.fn_get_article_list` via Dapper. Supports filtering by keyword, category ULID, author ULID, status (`Draft`, `PendingReview`, `Published`, `Archived`), `IsFeatured`, and `IsSpotlight`.
Fetches full article details by 26-char ULID via `dbo.fn_get_article_by_id`.

formdata.value: How minimalist spaces shape modern thought

formdata.description: Fallback URL if CoverPhoto file is not selected

request.description: Creates a new article via `multipart/form-data` supporting direct `CoverPhoto` upload and structured `GalleryItems[i]` multi-photo uploads with compensating file rollback.

formdata.value: How minimalist spaces and natural light shape modern thought
Revised essay exploring spatial harmony, acoustic stillness, and tactile materials...

formdata.description: Optional new cover image file to replace current cover

formdata.value: Concrete pavilion in Kyoto at dawn.

formdata.description: Optional new gallery photo to append
Optional ULID of an existing gallery photo to soft-delete

request.description: Updates an article's content, replaces cover photo, appends `NewGalleryItems[i]`, or soft-deletes `RemoveArticlePhotoIds`.
Changes an article's editorial status (`Draft`, `PendingReview`, `Published`, `Archived`) and toggles `IsFeatured` / `IsSpotlight`. Sets `PublishedAt` automatically when transitioning to `Published`.
Soft-deletes an article and all its gallery photos (`IsDeleted = true`).
Permanently deletes physical files on disk and DB rows for soft-deleted `Tbl_ArticlePhoto` records older than `RetentionDays` (default 30 days).

item.name: 1.4 Request Article (Pitches)
item.description: Review and manage reader/writer article pitches (`Tbl_RequestArticle`).

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of submitted article pitches via `dbo.fn_get_request_article_list`.
Fetches a single pitch submission by its 26-char ULID via `dbo.fn_get_request_article_by_id`.
Updates the review status (`Pending`, `Approved`, `Rejected`), `AdminNotes`, `ReviewedAt`, and `ReviewedByAdminId` for a pitch.
Fetches the generated OpenAPI v1 specification JSON for `MagizineAdmin.Api` (Development environment).

item.name: 2. MagizineAuthor.Api (Port 5267)
item.description:
Author Portal API (`MagizineAuthor.Api`).

Strictly scopes article queries and mutations to the authenticated author (`AuthorizedAuthorId = 01JAUTHOR00000000000000001`).

request.description: Returns all active article categories (`Result<List<ArticleCategoryResModel>>`) to populate the category selector when an author writes a draft.
Lists articles belonging strictly to the logged-in author (`AuthorizedAuthorId`).
Retrieves an article by ID only if it belongs to the authenticated author.

item.name: 3. MagizinePublic.Api (Port 5080)
item.description:
Public Reader API (`MagizinePublic.Api`).

Provides unauthenticated read access to published articles, active categories, and public article pitch submissions.

request.description: Returns all active article categories ordered by `SortOrder` and `Name`.
Fetches a single active category by its URL slug (e.g., `beauty`, `health-care`, `musing`).

query.description: Optional keyword search in Title or SubTitle

request.description: Returns only `Published` articles via `dbo.fn_get_article_list` with optional query parameters for search, category, author, featured, and spotlight.
